segments.name: Emergency Top Up Only
segments.definition: Shoppers who use quick commerce strictly for urgent last-minute needs or out-of-stock household items when stepping out is impossible.
segments.inclusion_rule: The review states ordering specifically because of an immediate kitchen emergency, a forgotten item, or needing something within minutes when unable to go out.
segments.distinguished_from: Unlike bulk or routine planners, these users rely on the app solely for instant rescue during sudden shortages.
example_quotes: Since, I have a toddler it’s not easy to get out anytime when home alone to get these simple essential stuffs. I am really glad that Blinkit ease to get on my hands on essential things specially.
I was expecting guest in 15 minutes and had to replenish grocery and eatables for them. Had no time to visit market for the same.
Suppose you are in kitchen and missing something then just Blinkit and you will get it in 10 minutes. 👍

segments.name: Discount Driven Hopper
segments.definition: Shoppers who constantly switch between different quick-commerce and e-commerce apps purely based on who offers the best coupons, cashbacks, and price cuts.
segments.inclusion_rule: The review explicitly mentions comparing app discounts, switching platforms due to better offers, or choosing based on coupons and cashbacks.
segments.distinguished_from: Unlike convenience-locked loyalists, these shoppers have no brand loyalty and jump apps for every rupee saved.
example_quotes: We don't straightaway buy When we see charges we explore if we have zepto like option which is taking no charges and giving great deals at the same time
Instamart is way way better than Blinkit Discount bahut deta hai 😅

I use zepto because of the free delivery on minimum INR 100 order value, I don't think in India, UX of app can be a game changer, based on the offers the brands are offering I'll choose according to that.

segments.name: Perishable Quality Skeptic
segments.definition: Shoppers who repeatedly face issues with fresh food, vegetables, fruits, or frozen items arriving damaged, melted, or spoiled.
segments.inclusion_rule: The review specifically complains about rotten vegetables, melted ice cream, stale fruits, or poor handling of temperature-sensitive perishables.
segments.distinguished_from: Unlike packaged goods buyers who focus on pricing, these users judge the service entirely on the physical condition of fresh and frozen items.
example_quotes: Ice creams are melting, due to lack of icy packs that are used previously in home delivery.
Ordered icecream candy and tub. But received melted icecream. Worst for ordering icecream or freezed items. 0/10 stars
sabziya and fruits taza hote hi nahi kabhi, freeze se nikal ke itne cold deti hai k fruits kha nahi sakte usi vakht, sabziya mix hoti hai todi achchi aur thodi bigadi huyi

segments.name: High Value Electronics Gambler
segments.definition: Shoppers who order expensive electronics, gadgets, or accessories through quick delivery apps and face severe post-purchase distress over defective items and unhelpful return policies.
segments.inclusion_rule: The review details purchasing gadgets, speakers, joysticks, or electronics and facing rejection during return requests or receiving counterfeit items.
segments.distinguished_from: Unlike routine grocery buyers, these customers deal with high financial stakes and inflexible return windows for non-grocery items.
example_quotes: I purchased a boat 108 stone it was damaged and they are not refunding the speaker they are saying to go to claim boat warranty
worst experience i ordered a sony joystick the outside pack was original but inside it is another brand something like ch its not used to play ps5 worst.
Guys pls dont buy electronics from blinkit agar inka kuch product bekar aaya too ye lot refund bhi nahi dege

segments.name: Convenience Addicted Loyalist
segments.definition: Shoppers who have completely replaced offline kirana shopping with quick commerce due to the sheer comfort of doorstep delivery and saving physical travel effort.
segments.inclusion_rule: The review expresses deep reliance on quick commerce for everyday orders, praising the time saved and avoidance of physical markets despite minor gripes.
segments.distinguished_from: Unlike price-sensitive critics or emergency-only users, these customers use quick apps habitually for regular household restocking.
example_quotes: I ordered everything online from tissue to television never had any major complaint my mother also started ordering vegetables and milk every day online now our offline spending near to 5%
as a customer i am toh happy, don't have to go anywhere for a package of oil or atta that do far below then retail store 😂
i think blinkit is the best grocery shopping app of India on time delivery polite and helpful delivery partner and products quality make it better than others
